statement: The proportion of mothers experiencing stressors during pregnancy among SUID cases is higher compared to the general population.
rationale: This design compares maternal stressor prevalence between SUID cases and live births, using appropriate sources within their coverage periods.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C10 discusses excluding certain death categories, but does not address maternal stressors directly. The question remains open as no prior work has compared these factors specifically in this context.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causation or incidence rates due to the lack of direct linkage between cases and denominators.
